conditions.scope: Registered living loaded residents; native Recruits/Jade presentation when installed. naturalRegeneration applies to new ordinary villager healing.

change.summary: Food-dependent resident regeneration; direct happiness fill and compact legible material-based native recruit interface.

modifiers.before: Ordinary registered villager serving updates satiety/mood only; no ongoing regeneration. Recruits already owns native healing.
modifiers.after: For loaded living registered villagers after an actual serving:1HP/80ticks while satiety>=90 and naturalRegeneration and health missing;4satiety/HP; persisted bounded timer, reset when ineligible; no offline catchup or revival. Native Recruits healing unchanged.

modifiers.before: Fully drawn happiness rail green-left/red-right and inverse moving nether-star marker.
modifiers.after: Actualpercent determines fill length; red-low-left/yellow/green-high-right; no moving star; smile and percentage retained; existing happiness calculation/decay unchanged.

modifiers.before: 300wide menu with dark stat/cost text, excess right space and168000tick wage tooltip.
modifiers.after: 252wide native menu, white statistics/costs on recessed dark surfaces; original36slots, real model, groups, requests and quotes unchanged; native wood/vines and shared pixel metal corners; game-day countdown/7day wage captions. Settlement navigation uses native item icons and shared controls.

cause.kind: Server resident lifecycle and client-only presentation

rationale.purpose: Implement exact user recovery/readability/layout feedback while preserving native Recruits authority and existing food/economy contracts.
rationale.decision_source: User requests recovery after food, decreasing happiness fill red-left, white Recruit text, days, less right whitespace; explicitly selects layout/icon reuse/materials. Codex chooses healing rate/cost,252width and native-material rendering.
